Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937 – In 1947, on the formation of India and Pakistan, the State of Rampur merged into the Union of India – Ruler of Rampur signed the Merger Agreement on 15.05.49 under which to full ownership, use and enjoyment of all private properties (as distinguished from State properties) belonging to him – Constitution of India came into force on 26.01.50 – Ruler died intestate – Certificate issued inter alia certifying the eldest son of the Ruler, defendant
